title: The V4 and the War in Ukraine
goal: I can describe how the Visegrád countries' positions on the war in Ukraine differed after 2022.
I can contrast two positions with *míg ..., addig ...* and *egyfelől ..., másfelől ...*.
I can say whose position I am describing, without taking a side.
